question: Will the winner of the 2026 Vuelta a España be Roglic or Pogacar?
resolution_criteria: If the GC winner on the podium after the final stage or the first GC winner announced by the race organization is Tadej Pogacar or Primoz Roglic, resolves Yes. Otherwise resolves No.
research:
## 1. Resolution source
- The race decides it: the GC winner on the final podium in Granada on 2026-09-13, or the first winner the organiser (lavuelta.es) announces. I could not open the official classification pages because the proxy blocked them, so the standings below come from news reports.
- 2026-08-29: The official Vuelta site published "Coquard sprints to victory, Pogacar abandons." [lavuelta.es](https://www.lavuelta.es/en/news/2026/coquard-sprints-to-victory-pogacar-abandons/58418)

## 2. Current status
- **Pogacar is out of the race, so Roglic is the only way this resolves Yes.**
- 2026-08-29: Pogacar crashed about 32 km from the finish of stage 8 and abandoned. Reported injuries were a concussion, a displaced left collarbone fracture and a stable C7 vertebra fracture. He had been leading Enric Mas by 3:50. [Irish Times](https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/2026/08/29/tadej-pogacar-abandons-vuelta-after-crash-on-stage-eight/), [Euronews](https://euronews.com/2026/08/29/pogacar-abandons-la-vuelta-after-heavy-crash-33km-from-finish), [Biketips](https://biketips.com/pogacar-abandons-vuelta-2026-crash/)
- 2026-09-03: GC after stage 12 (Calar Alto): Mas (Movistar) leads, Roglic (Red Bull-Bora) is 2nd at 1:45, Gall 3rd at 2:06, Carapaz 4th at 3:53, Onley 5th at 4:29 and Omrzel 6th at 4:59. Mas gained 27 seconds on Roglic, Gall and Carapaz that day. [ProCyclingUK](https://procyclinguk.com/vuelta-a-espana-2026-stage-12-jakob-omrzel-wins-on-calar-alto-as-enric-mas-extends-red-jersey-lead/), [Cyclingnews](https://www.cyclingnews.com/pro-cycling/racing/vuelta-a-espana-jakob-omrzel-wins-stage-12-as-enric-mas-has-another-stellar-ride-on-calar-alto/)
- Nothing settles the question yet. Nine stages are left.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-04: Stage 13 runs today, 192.8 km from Almuñécar to Loja. It is a medium-mountain stage expected to go to a breakaway, and the last classified climb comes about 37 km from the finish. [Cyclingnews preview](https://www.cyclingnews.com/pro-cycling/racing/vuelta-a-espana-2026-stage-13-preview/), [ProCyclingUK](https://procyclinguk.com/vuelta-a-espana-2026-stage-13-preview-van-aert-nys-and-cort-face-a-breakaway-battle-on-the-road-to-loja/)
- 2026-09-03: Cyclingnews described Roglic's race as "an uphill battle" after Calar Alto, quoting him: "We'll keep on fighting." His 27-second loss there was more than double the 12 seconds he lost at Aitana. [Cyclingnews](https://www.cyclingnews.com/pro-cycling/racing/well-keep-on-fighting-vuelta-a-espana-an-uphill-battle-for-primoz-roglic-after-enric-mas-gains-time-on-calar-alto/)
- Around 2026-08-30 to 09-01: Mas took the red jersey after Pogacar left the race and won stage 9. [FloBikes](https://www.flobikes.com/articles/16150475-la-vuelta-standings-after-stage-9-see-whos-leading)

## 4. Base rates
- Roglic has won the Vuelta four times: 2019, 2020, 2021 and 2024. In 2024 he overturned a large GC deficit to Ben O'Connor in the final week (from my background knowledge).
- Mas has never won a Grand Tour. He finished 2nd at the Vuelta in 2018, 2021 and 2022 (background knowledge).
- One preview argued that in flat time trials of 25 to 34 km, Roglic has typically been 1:30 to 2:00 or more faster than Mas. The stage 18 time trial is about 32.5 km and is flat to slightly rolling. [IDL Pro Cycling](https://www.idlprocycling.com/cycling/321-kilometers-146-to-claw-back-heres-the-maths-primoz-roglic-needs-to-know-to-overhaul-mas-at-the-vuelta). This article is undated in my results and may have been published after 2026-09-04. I am only using its general point about past time trial gaps.
- Roglic is 36 and one source describes him as past his peak. On the climbs this year, Mas has gained time on him every time.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a market on this exact question ("Will the winner of the 2026 Vuelta..."). A search snippet put Roglic at about 16% in September, but I could not open the page to check the price or its date. It is a small, thinly traded market. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Eliza/will-the-winner-of-the-2026-vuelta)
- CyclingUpToDate ran a reader poll after Pogacar's exit (Mas, Roglic, Onley or someone else). I could not see the results. [CyclingUpToDate](https://cyclinguptodate.com/cycling/poll-enric-mas-primoz-roglic-oscar-onley-or-someone-else-who-wins-the-wide-open-2026-vuelta-a-espana-after-tadej-pogacars-exit)
- I found no bookmaker odds or Polymarket or Kalshi markets dated on or before 2026-09-04.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-04: Stage 13, Loja (medium mountain).
- 2026-09-05: Stage 14, summit finish at Sierra de la Pandera (about 153 km, short and very steep finish). [Cycling Oracle route](https://www.cyclingoracle.com/en/blog/vuelta-a-espana-2026-route)
- 2026-09-06: Stage 15 to Córdoba (medium mountain), then a rest day on 09-07.
- 2026-09-08 and 09-09: Stages 16 and 17, both flat.
- 2026-09-10: **Stage 18, individual time trial** from El Puerto de Santa María to Jerez (32.3 to 32.5 km, flat and exposed to wind). This is Roglic's main chance to take back 1:45. [Tour-Magazin](https://www.tour-magazin.de/en/professional-cycling/vuelta/vuelta-a-espana-this-is-where-the-battle-for-the-red-jersey-will-be-decided/), [Domestique](https://www.domestiquecycling.com/en/cycling-races/vuelta-a-espana/2026/stage-profiles/)
- 2026-09-11: Stage 19 to Peñas Blancas (205 km, summit finish).
- 2026-09-12: Stage 20, likely a summit finish in the Sierra Nevada (Collado del Alguacil). Only a tour-operator source gives this detail, so it is unconfirmed. [Cycling Stage](https://www.cyclingstage.com/vuelta-2026-route/spain-route-2026/)
- 2026-09-13: Stage 21 in Granada, normally a ceremonial stage.
- Crashes, illness or abandonments by Mas or Roglic could still change the outcome.
